question: Ryan, 2026-09-07: 'FIRST determine the Gerber NLTE grid's wavelength DOMAIN. If it covers a band, run synth-1D-LTE-gerber + ENGINE-B-NLTE on every holding there. If the grid is VIS-only (like Amarsi), record that as the documented reason -- do not force it.'
answer: NOT VIS-only. Runnable on VIS and red-optical; refused on near-UV, NIR and H, and on Fe II everywhere.
how_it_was_measured: The domain is NOT the atom file's lambda cut. atom.fe607a is cut at log gf > -5 and lambda < 20000 A, which would admit every band we hold below 2 um and is therefore the WRONG test -- it describes the deck, not whether a given line can take a departure.

What decides is whether the SYNTHESIS LINE LIST carries an NLTE label for the line. Turbospectrum's fallback is departure = 1 PER LINE, so partial coverage never raises: it DILUTES (RYA-1050). A band at half coverage emits a well-formed NLTE product carrying roughly half the effect, and nothing records it.

Measured with pipeline.gerber_nlte.pool_label_coverage over THE POOL THAT WOULD BE FITTED, not the window. RYA-1050's own example: Fe II 4200-6910 passes a WINDOW check on 854 labelled lines it never touches, then synthesises all eleven lines it does touch in LTE under an NLTE label.

VIS.verdict: RUNNABLE for Fe I; Fe II LTE-leg only

red-optical.verdict: RUNNABLE - this is the new one; the Gerber route was on no non-VIS holding before this ticket

H.verdict: PARTIAL 13/25 - REFUSED. This is the RYA-1050 dilution case exactly: it would emit a well-formed NLTE product carrying about half the effect, with nothing recording that it did.

fe_ii_nlte: Structurally unavailable and re-confirmed at POOL level here: 0 of 9 VIS Fe II lines carry an NLTE label. Consistent with RYA-1055 (atom.fe607a's 12,635 bound-bound transitions are all Fe I->Fe I; its 58 Fe II levels are a reservoir). The Fe II Gerber LTE leg was run; ENGINE-B-NLTE is a documented N/A, not a phantom.

engine_a_domain.finding: MPIA (Bergemann per-line delta_nlte, the ENGINE-A source) serves Fe I through the J band and stops before H.
engine_a_domain.why_it_was_checked: The CRIRES+ H run reported '20 of 20 lines unserved', and a DOWN SERVICE produces that same message. The service was live at the time: the VIS gate lines returned data in the same session. So the H gap is real, not an outage.
engine_a_domain.trap: A MIXED BATCH RETURNS NOTHING. VIS lines alone are served; VIS + H together return an empty result div. build_nlte_grids_mpia.py batches 20 lines per request, so a single out-of-range line silently converts a partial gap into a total one for its whole batch. Not triggered here (all 20 H lines are out of range) but latent for any band straddling the edge.

what_was_run: Gerber LTE+NLTE pair on Fe I VIS (IAG, HARPS) and Fe I red-optical (IAG, kurucz2005, molecfit); Gerber LTE only on Fe II VIS (3 holdings). CRIRES+ H Fe I 1D-LTE. Nothing was forced where coverage was partial or absent.

nlte_differential_measured.note: ENGINE-B-NLTE minus its own synth-1D-LTE-gerber sibling -- the NLTE effect on ONE atmosphere (RYA-542), never against 1D-LTE, which would report the atmosphere shift as non-LTE physics.
nlte_differential_measured.reading: All seven positive, +0.029 to +0.057, median about +0.044. The three NEW red-optical cells agree with the four VIS cells, so the correction is stable across bands and holdings on matched pools.
